goal.ko: 익힌 물건이 있는지 묻고 장소를 짧게 확인한다
goal.en: Ask whether familiar objects are present and check their location.
goal.de: Frage nach vertrauten Gegenständen und kläre, wo sie sind.

base_manuscript.inheritance: full dialogue, teaching, P/I/R items, answer criteria, help and feedback retained verbatim; overlay is additive

source_contract.title: 무엇이 어디에 있나요
source_contract.can_do: 익힌 물건이 있는지 묻고 장소를 짧게 확인한다
source_contract.teach: 물건의 뜻·소리를 먼저 연결한 뒤 새 정보 이·가; 있다·없다의 해요체를 각각 시범
source_contract.practice: 가려진 물건의 유무를 서로 물어 위치 찾기
source_contract.transfer: 다른 배치의 분실물 자리에서 유무를 확인; 학습 범위 밖 표지는 번역

context.ko: 화자는 선반 앞. 화자 가까이 모자, 멀리 가방. R에서는 다른 방의 다른 선반을 사용해요.
context.en: The speaker stands at the shelf: 모자 nearby, 가방 farther away. R uses a different shelf in another room.
context.de: Die sprechende Person steht am Regal: 모자 in der Nähe, 가방 weiter weg. R verwendet ein anderes Regal in einem anderen Raum.

prompt.ko: 가까운 물건이 어디에 있는지 상대에게 알려요.
prompt.en: Tell your partner what is nearby.
prompt.de: Sage der anderen Person, welcher Gegenstand in der Nähe ist.

items.required_control: ORAL-START: choose explanation language; demonstrate play, reply and optional help before task
items.relationship: known house companions; gatekeeper roleplay; polite Korean to elder characters

level1.ko: 카메라가 아니라 말하는 사람 가까운 쪽을 봐요.
level1.en: Look near the speaker, regardless of camera position.
level1.de: Achte auf die Nähe zur sprechenden Person, unabhängig von der Kameraposition.

level2.ko: 같은 상황의 시범을 듣고 함께 해요.
level2.en: Listen to a model for this situation and try with support.
level2.de: Hör dir ein Beispiel für diese Situation an und probiere es mit Hilfe.

help_policy.effect: same-audio replay logged; translation/form/model/first-syllable support changes target independence; retry remains same item

wrong_feedback.ko: 물건 이름과 화자의 위치를 따로 확인해요. 다른 조사를 써도 뜻이 통했는지는 별도로 남겨요.
wrong_feedback.en: Check the object and the speaker’s position separately. If you use a different particle, record whether the meaning was still clear.
wrong_feedback.de: Prüfe Gegenstand und Standort getrennt. Bei einer anderen Partikel wird zusätzlich festgehalten, ob die Aussage verständlich war.

accepted_response_policy.rule: Accept 여기(에) 가방이/모자가 있어요 and meaningful omission/topic alternatives. Presence and referent must match; particle production is separately observed. Pointing without language = supported action, no sentence production.
accepted_response_policy.target_observation: Observe only the listed grammar function; an alternative grammatical form can achieve communication without demonstrating this target.

context.ko: 전체가 보이는 작은 칸을 확인했어요. 그 칸에는 가방 없음. 집의 다른 곳은 확인하지 않았어요.
context.en: You checked the whole small compartment. There is no 가방 in it. Other parts of the house have not been checked.
context.de: Du hast das ganze kleine Fach geprüft. Darin ist kein 가방. Andere Bereiche des Hauses wurden nicht geprüft.

prompt.ko: 확인한 칸에 그 물건이 있는지 말해요.
prompt.en: Say whether that object is in the checked compartment.
prompt.de: Sage, ob der Gegenstand im geprüften Fach liegt.

items.required_control: ORAL-START: choose explanation language; demonstrate play, reply and optional help before task
items.relationship: known house companions; gatekeeper roleplay; polite Korean to elder characters

level1.ko: 전체를 확인한 작은 칸의 유무만 말해요.
level1.en: Report presence or absence only for the fully checked compartment.
level1.de: Sprich nur über das vollständig geprüfte kleine Fach.

level2.ko: 같은 상황의 시범을 듣고 함께 해요.
level2.en: Listen to a model for this situation and try with support.
level2.de: Hör dir ein Beispiel für diese Situation an und probiere es mit Hilfe.

help_policy.effect: same-audio replay logged; translation/form/model/first-syllable support changes target independence; retry remains same item

wrong_feedback.ko: 있어요는 있는 경우예요. 이번 칸은 확인했고 그 물건이 없어요.
wrong_feedback.en: 있어요 means it is present. This compartment has been checked and does not contain that object.
wrong_feedback.de: 있어요 bedeutet, dass etwas vorhanden ist. Dieses Fach wurde geprüft; der Gegenstand ist nicht darin.

accepted_response_policy.rule: Open replies: accept equivalent meaning, speech act and appropriate politeness. Record requested target form separately. Choice items require the stated referent; no unrelated paraphrase substitution.
accepted_response_policy.target_observation: Observe only the listed grammar function; an alternative grammatical form can achieve communication without demonstrating this target.

context.ko: 그림: 화자 곁 흰 칸=모자, 화자에게서 먼 갈색 칸=가방. 카메라는 R에서 반대편이에요. 음성: 저기 가방이 있어요.
context.en: Picture: hat near speaker in white compartment; bag farther away in brown compartment. R reverses camera position. Audio: 저기 가방이 있어요.
